properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail
properties.query:
// Control-plane activity across all Alibaba Cloud services
// Two exclusions:
// * eventType == "AliyunServiceEvent", Alibaba's own service-linked roles
//   (AliyunServiceRoleFor*) and *.aliyuncs.com system principals acting on the tenant's
//   behalf.
// * serviceName in ("Ims","CloudSSO","Ram"), covered by the UserManagement parser.
let vimAuditEventAlibabaCloudActionTrail = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresult: string = '*'
    , actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , operation_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , object_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , newvalue_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]) // NewValue is not populated by this source, accepted for unifying-parser compatibility.
    , disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    AliCloudActionTrailLogs_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnotempty(eventName)
    | where eventType != "AliyunServiceEvent"
    | where serviceName !in ("Ims", "CloudSSO", "Ram")
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or eventName has_any (operation_has_any)
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(sourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or ipv6_is_in_any_range(sourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 // NewValue not available in source
    | extend
        _ErrorCode = trim(@'"', errorCode)
        , _ActorUsername = tostring(userIdentity.userName)
        , _ResourceNameFirst = tostring(split(resourceName, ";")[0])
    | extend
        _EventResult = iff(isempty(_ErrorCode) and isempty(errorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
        , _EventType = case(
            eventName startswith "Terminate", "Terminate"
            , eventName startswith "Create" or eventName startswith "Add" or eventName startswith "Register"
                or eventName startswith "Allocate" or eventName startswith "Insert" or eventName startswith "New"
                or eventName startswith "Upload" or eventName startswith "Copy" or eventName startswith "Clone"
                or eventName startswith "Generate" or eventName startswith "Provision",
                "Create"
            , eventName startswith "Delete" or eventName startswith "Remove" or eventName startswith "Release"
                or eventName startswith "Deregister" or eventName startswith "Cancel" or eventName startswith "Drop"
                or eventName startswith "Uninstall" or eventName startswith "Deprovision",
                "Delete"
            , eventName startswith "Describe" or eventName startswith "List" or eventName startswith "Get"
                or eventName startswith "Query" or eventName startswith "Check" or eventName startswith "Download"
                or eventName startswith "Export" or eventName startswith "Search" or eventName startswith "Fetch"
                or eventName startswith "Discover" or eventName startswith "Recognize" or eventName startswith "Preview"
                or eventName startswith "Validate" or eventName startswith "Diagnose" or eventName startswith "Count",
                "Read"
            , eventName startswith "Modify" or eventName startswith "Update" or eventName startswith "Set"
                or eventName startswith "Change" or eventName startswith "Attach" or eventName startswith "Detach"
                or eventName startswith "Tag" or eventName startswith "Untag" or eventName startswith "Config"
                or eventName startswith "Associate" or eventName startswith "Disassociate" or eventName startswith "Move"
                or eventName startswith "Grant" or eventName startswith "Revoke" or eventName startswith "Authorize"
                or eventName startswith "Put" or eventName startswith "Upsert" or eventName startswith "Write"
                or eventName startswith "Save" or eventName startswith "Apply" or eventName startswith "Bind"
                or eventName startswith "Unbind" or eventName startswith "Import" or eventName startswith "Scale"
                or eventName startswith "Resize" or eventName startswith "Renew" or eventName startswith "Upgrade"
                or eventName startswith "Downgrade" or eventName startswith "Migrate" or eventName startswith "Sync"
                or eventName startswith "Rename" or eventName startswith "Operate" or eventName startswith "Handle"
                or eventName startswith "Complete" or eventName startswith "Confirm" or eventName startswith "Approve"
                or eventName startswith "Reject" or eventName startswith "Join" or eventName startswith "Leave"
                or eventName startswith "Mount" or eventName startswith "Rollback" or eventName startswith "Repair",
                "Set"
            , eventName startswith "Enable" or eventName startswith "Open", "Enable"
            , eventName startswith "Disable" or eventName startswith "Close", "Disable"
            , eventName startswith "Run" or eventName startswith "Invoke" or eventName startswith "Execute", "Execute"
            , eventName startswith "Start" or eventName startswith "Restart" or eventName startswith "Reboot", "Start"
            , eventName startswith "Stop" or eventName startswith "Suspend" or eventName startswith "Pause", "Stop"
            , eventName startswith "Install" or eventName startswith "Deploy", "Install"
            , eventName startswith "Init", "Initialize"
            , eventName startswith "Clear" or eventName startswith "Reset" or eventName startswith "Purge", "Clear"
            , eventRW == "Read", "Read"
            , "Other"
        )
        , _Object = case(isnotempty(_ResourceNameFirst), _ResourceNameFirst, isnotempty(serviceName), serviceName, "Not Applicable")
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or _EventType in (eventtype_in)
    | where eventresult == '*' or eventresult == _EventResult
    | where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or _ActorUsername has_any (actorusername_has_any)
    | where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or _Object has_any (object_has_any)
    | extend
        _ActorUserType = tostring(userIdentity.type)
        , _ActorUserId = tostring(userIdentity.principalId)
        , _ResourceTypeFirst = tostring(split(resourceType, ";")[0])
        // sourceIPAddress can be an IP or an Alibaba hostname.
        , _SrcIsIp = ipv4_is_match(sourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0") or ipv6_is_match(sourceIpAddress, "::/0")
        , _EventSourceHasDot = eventSource has "."
    | extend
        // ActionTrail resource types are ACS::<Namespace>::<Kind>, e.g. ACS::ECS::Instance.
        _AcsNamespace = tostring(split(_ResourceTypeFirst, "::")[1])
        , _AcsKind = tostring(split(_ResourceTypeFirst, "::")[2])
    | extend
        EventCount = int(1)
        , EventStartTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventEndTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventVendor = "Alibaba Cloud"
        , EventProduct = "ActionTrail"
        , EventSchema = "AuditEvent"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , EventResult = _EventResult
        , EventResultDetails = _ErrorCode
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = errorMessage
        , EventMessage = errorMessage
        , EventSeverity = iff(isnotempty(_ErrorCode) or isnotempty(errorMessage), "Low", "Informational")
        , EventOriginalSubType = eventCategory
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , EventType = _EventType
        , Dvc = "ActionTrail"
        , DvcAction = eventRW
        , TargetFQDN = iff(_EventSourceHasDot, eventSource, "")
        , TargetHostname = iff(_EventSourceHasDot, tostring(split(eventSource, ".")[0]), "")
        , TargetDomain = iff(_EventSourceHasDot, substring(eventSource, indexof(eventSource, ".") + 1), "")
        , TargetDomainType = iff(_EventSourceHasDot, "FQDN", "")
        , Object = _Object
        // referencedResources is the structured form of resourceName/resourceType, keyed by ACS type:
        // {"ACS::ECS::Disk": ["d-2ze7e8..."]}.
        , ObjectId = tostring(referencedResources[tostring(bag_keys(referencedResources)[0])][0])
        , ObjectType = case(
            isempty(_ResourceTypeFirst), "Other"
            , _AcsNamespace in ("RAM", "CloudSSO", "IMS"), "Directory Service Object"
            , _AcsKind in ("Policy", "Rule", "ControlPolicy", "AccessConfiguration"), "Policy Rule"
            , _AcsNamespace == "SLS", "Event Log"
            , _AcsKind in ("Service", "Function", "Application"), "Service"
            , _AcsKind in ("Job", "Task", "ScheduledTask"), "Scheduled Task"
            , "Cloud Resource"
        )
        , OriginalObjectType = _ResourceTypeFirst
        , ActorUserId = _ActorUserId
        , ActorUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(_ActorUserId), "Other", "")
        , ActorUsername = _ActorUsername
        , ActorUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(_ActorUsername), "Simple", "")
        , ActorUserType = case(
            _ActorUserType == "ram-user", "Regular"
            , _ActorUserType == "root-account", "Admin"
            , _ActorUserType == "system", "System"
            , _ActorUserType == "assumed-role", "Service"
            , _ActorUserType in ("cloudsso-user", "saml-user", "oidc-user"), "Regular"
            , "Other"
        )
        , ActorOriginalUserType = _ActorUserType
        , ActorScopeId = tostring(userIdentity.accountId)
        // assumed-role principalIds are "<roleId>:<sessionName>"
        , ActorSessionId = iff(_ActorUserId contains ":", tostring(split(_ActorUserId, ":")[1]), "")
        , TargetAppName = serviceName
        , TargetAppType = iff(isnotempty(serviceName), "Service", "")
        , SrcIpAddr = iff(_SrcIsIp, sourceIpAddress, "")
        , SrcFQDN = iff(not(_SrcIsIp) and sourceIpAddress has ".", sourceIpAddress, "")
    | extend
        Application = TargetAppName
        , Dst = coalesce(TargetFQDN, TargetAppName)
        , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
        , Src = SrcIpAddr
        , User = ActorUsername
    | project-rename
        Operation = eventName
        , EventOriginalUid = eventId
        , EventOriginalType = eventType
        , EventProductVersion = eventVersion
        , HttpUserAgent = userAgent
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , pack(
                "eventSource", eventSource
                , "eventRW", eventRW
                , "requestId", requestId
                , "requestParameters", requestParameters
                , "requestParameterJson", requestParameterJson
                , "responseElements", responseElements
                , "additionalEventData", additionalEventData
                , "referencedResources", referencedResources
                , "eventAttributes", eventAttributes
                , "apiVersion", apiVersion
                , "isGlobal", isGlobal
                , "acsRegion", acsRegion
                , "actorAccessKeyId", tostring(userIdentity.accessKeyId)
                , "resourceName", resourceName
                , "resourceType", resourceType
            )
            , dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , EventCount
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , EventSeverity
        , EventProduct
        , EventVendor
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , EventUid
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalSubType
        , EventOriginalResultDetails
        , EventMessage
        , EventProductVersion
        , Dvc
        , DvcAction
        , Operation
        , Object
        , ObjectId
        , ObjectType
        , OriginalObjectType
        , ActorUserId
        , ActorUserIdType
        , ActorUsername
        , ActorUsernameType
        , ActorUserType
        , ActorOriginalUserType
        , ActorScopeId
        , ActorSessionId
        , TargetAppName
        , TargetAppType
        , TargetFQDN
        , TargetHostname
        , TargetDomain
        , TargetDomainType
        , Application
        , Dst
        , SrcIpAddr
        , SrcFQDN
        , Src
        , IpAddr
        , User
        , HttpUserAgent
        , AdditionalFields
        , Type
};
vimAuditEventAlibabaCloudActionTrail(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    eventtype_in=eventtype_in,
    eventresult=eventresult,
    actorusername_has_any=actorusername_has_any,
    operation_has_any=operation_has_any,
    object_has_any=object_has_any,
    newvalue_has_any=newvalue_has_any,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack)
